question: Which of the chemical formulae represents bleaching powder?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ca(ClO)₂**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The chemical formula of **bleaching powder** is **CaOCl₂**, which is also known as **calcium oxychloride**.
 
• Bleaching powder is prepared by passing **chlorine gas (Cl₂)** over **dry slaked lime (Ca(OH)₂)**.
 
• The chemical reaction involved in the preparation of bleaching powder is: **Ca(OH)₂ + Cl₂ → Ca(ClO)₂ + H₂O**.
 
• Bleaching powder is commonly used as a **disinfectant**, **oxidising agent**, and for **bleaching cotton, linen, and paper pulp**.
 
• I
